props.name: controller
props.description: The controller managing this component's state and behaviour. Bind to it to access the component's imperative API.

props.name: onfirstcreate
props.description: A callback that fires when the component's controller is first created.

props.name: children
props.description: The child content of the board, which should contain the inner FlexiTarget and FlexiWidget components.

props.name: config
props.description: The configuration object for the board.

props.name: class
props.description: The class names to apply to the board's root element.

props.name: suspense
props.description: Fallback content shown while the board's server-rendered layout is provisional: a stored layout that hasn't been imported yet, or an unconfirmed responsive breakpoint guess. Server-rendered alongside the board and toggled by generated CSS, so it applies from the very first paint; it unmounts once the layout is confirmed at hydration.

propsReact.name: onfirstcreate
propsReact.description: A callback that fires when the component's controller is first created.

propsReact.name: children
propsReact.description: The child content of the board, which should contain the inner FlexiTarget and FlexiWidget components.

propsReact.name: className
propsReact.description: The class names to apply to the board's root element.

propsReact.name: suspense
propsReact.description: Fallback content shown while the board's server-rendered layout is provisional: a stored layout that hasn't been imported yet, or an unconfirmed responsive breakpoint guess. Server-rendered alongside the board and toggled by generated CSS, so it applies from the very first paint; it unmounts once the layout is confirmed after mount.

properties.name: style
properties.description: The reactive styling to apply to the board's root element.

properties.name: ref
properties.description: The reactive DOM reference to the board's root element.

properties.name: breakpoint
properties.description: The breakpoint that the board corresponds to, if the board is responsive.

properties.name: layoutPending
properties.description: Whether the board's rendered layout is provisional: a `loadLayout` (or `loadLayouts`) is configured but hasn't run yet. True throughout a server render and during hydration until the stored layout is imported. Adapters expose it in the markup (`data-flexi-pending="layout"`) so a skeleton or veil can cover the stand-in layout.

properties.name: breakpointPending
properties.description: The breakpoint this render is assuming without confirmation, or null once it's real. Non-null only for a board under a ResponsiveFlexiBoard during a server render, where the rendered breakpoint is a guess. Adapters emit it as `data-flexi-pending="<key>"` (unless layoutPending takes priority) so a stylesheet can veil the board only when the viewport doesn't match the guess.

properties.name: currentWidgetAction
properties.description: The move or resize the user is in the middle of, or null when idle. Reactive: read it during render to react to a drag starting and ending.

methods.name: moveWidget
methods.type: (widget: FlexiWidgetController, from: FlexiTargetController | undefined, to: FlexiTargetController) => void
methods.description: Moves an existing widget from one target to another.

methods.name: importLayout
methods.description: Imports a widget layout into the board: a bare layout, or the `{ version, layout }` envelope that `exportLayoutEnvelope()` returns.

methods.name: exportLayout
methods.description: Exports the current widget layout of the board.

methods.name: exportLayoutEnvelope
methods.description: Exports the layout with its format version, the shape to persist so a later release can migrate it on import.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes every widget in every target of this board. Fires `onWidgetDelete` per widget and `onLayoutChange` once.

FlexiBoardConfiguration.name: widgetDefaults
FlexiBoardConfiguration.description: The default configuration for widgets within this board.

FlexiBoardConfiguration.name: targetDefaults
FlexiBoardConfiguration.description: The default configuration for targets within this board.

FlexiBoardConfiguration.name: breakpoint
FlexiBoardConfiguration.description: Optional breakpoint override. When this board is inside a ResponsiveFlexiBoard, the breakpoint is automatically inferred from the responsive controller's `currentBreakpoint`. You typically don't need to set this manually. If set outside of a ResponsiveFlexiBoard context, a warning will be logged.

FlexiBoardConfiguration.name: registry
FlexiBoardConfiguration.description: A registry of widget types, mapping type keys to shared widget configuration. Widgets reference an entry via their `type`.

FlexiBoardConfiguration.name: initialLayout
FlexiBoardConfiguration.description: A layout to render from instead of the widgets declared in markup, as a plain value keyed by target. Applied during the initial render pass on both the server and the client, so a layout fetched in a server `load` (e.g. from a database) server-renders at its final positions with no pending window. Requires a `registry` to resolve each entry's `type`. Targets without an entry here fall back to their declared widgets. A configured `loadLayout` still runs on the client and overrides this.

FlexiBoardConfiguration.name: loadLayout
FlexiBoardConfiguration.description: Function to load an initial layout on mount. Called once when the board is ready. Not invoked during server rendering. Use `initialLayout` for layouts the server already has.

FlexiBoardConfiguration.name: onLayoutChange
FlexiBoardConfiguration.description: Callback fired when the board's layout changes (widget moved, resized, added, or removed), whether by the user or through the controller API. Debounced; receives the exported layout.

FlexiBoardConfiguration.name: onWidgetGrab
FlexiBoardConfiguration.description: Called when the user picks a widget up (by pointer or keyboard).

FlexiBoardConfiguration.name: onWidgetDrop
FlexiBoardConfiguration.description: Called when a widget the user was moving or resizing lands in a target. Fires after the placement is committed, so the widget's `x`, `y`, `width`, `height` and `target` are already final.

FlexiBoardConfiguration.name: onWidgetCancel
FlexiBoardConfiguration.description: Called when the user cancels a move or resize (Escape, or releasing where nothing accepts the widget); the widget is back where it started.

FlexiBoardConfiguration.name: onWidgetDelete
FlexiBoardConfiguration.description: Called when a widget is deleted, by dropping it on a FlexiDelete or by calling `widget.delete()`.

FlexiBoardConfiguration.name: onWidgetResize
FlexiBoardConfiguration.description: Called when a resize the user was making commits. The widget's `width` and `height` are already final.

FlexiBoardConfiguration.name: onWidgetEnterTarget
FlexiBoardConfiguration.description: Called when a widget being moved is carried over a target, which then shows a drop preview for it.

FlexiBoardConfiguration.name: onWidgetLeaveTarget
FlexiBoardConfiguration.description: Called when a widget being moved leaves the target it was over.

FlexiBoardConfiguration.name: canDrop
FlexiBoardConfiguration.description: Decides whether a widget may be placed at a position. Called while the user hovers (so the drop preview can show a rejection) and again on release. Return false to refuse: the widget stays where it was. Placement rules the grid already enforces (bounds, collisions) run regardless.

FlexiBoardConfiguration.name: portalDropFlights
FlexiBoardConfiguration.description: Hosts drop flights in the fixed, viewport-level portal instead of flying them inside the board. Reach for this when drops are released outside the board's box and must fly in across its edge without clipping under the board's overflow lock (e.g. a small hero board mid-page). Leave it off for scrollable boards: a portalled flight escapes the scroll container's clip and paints above surrounding chrome for its duration.

FlexiBoardConfiguration.name: autoScroll
FlexiBoardConfiguration.description: Scrolls the board's scrollable ancestors (the page included) while a drag or resize hovers within 48px of their visible edge. Turn it off for boards that sit on a page where a drag should never move the viewport (e.g. a marketing hero). An unexpected page scroll mid-drag reads as the board jumping.

FlexiTargetDefaults.name: rowSizing
FlexiTargetDefaults.type: string | (({ target, grid }: { target: FlexiTargetController; grid: FlexiGrid }) => string)
FlexiTargetDefaults.description: Allows the specifying of the value inside the `repeat()` function of the `grid-template-rows` CSS property for the target.

FlexiTargetDefaults.name: columnSizing
FlexiTargetDefaults.type: string | (({ target, grid }: { target: FlexiTargetController; grid: FlexiGrid }) => string)
FlexiTargetDefaults.description: Allows the specifying of the value inside the `repeat()` function of the `grid-template-columns` CSS property for the target.

FlexiTargetDefaults.name: layout
FlexiTargetDefaults.description: The layout algorithm and parameters to use for the target grid.

FlexiWidgetDefaults.name: snippet
FlexiWidgetDefaults.description: The snippet that is rendered by this widget.

FlexiWidgetDefaults.name: component
FlexiWidgetDefaults.description: The component that is rendered by this widget.

FlexiWidgetDefaults.name: componentProps
FlexiWidgetDefaults.description: The props applied to the component rendered, if it has one.

FlexiWidgetDefaults.name: className
FlexiWidgetDefaults.description: The class names to apply to this widget.

FlexiWidgetDefaults.name: transition
FlexiWidgetDefaults.description: The transition configuration for this widget.

FlexiWidgetDefaults.name: grabTrigger
FlexiWidgetDefaults.description: The configuration for how pointer events should trigger a grab event on the widget. E.g. a long press.

FlexiWidgetDefaults.name: resizeTrigger
FlexiWidgetDefaults.description: The configuration for how pointer events should trigger a resize event on the widget. E.g. a long press.

FlexiWidgetDefaults.name: minWidth
FlexiWidgetDefaults.description: The minimum width of the widget in units. Defaults to 1, cannot be less than 1.

FlexiWidgetDefaults.name: minHeight
FlexiWidgetDefaults.description: The minimum height of the widget in units. Defaults to 1, cannot be less than 1.

FlexiWidgetDefaults.name: maxWidth
FlexiWidgetDefaults.description: The maximum width of the widget in units. Defaults to Infinity, cannot be less than 1.

FlexiWidgetDefaults.name: maxHeight
FlexiWidgetDefaults.description: The maximum height of the widget in units. Defaults to Infinity, cannot be less than 1.

FlexiWidgetLayoutEntry.name: id
FlexiWidgetLayoutEntry.description: A stable identifier for this widget. Always present in an export: the id you gave the widget, or a generated one. Round-trips through import.

FlexiWidgetLayoutEntry.name: type
FlexiWidgetLayoutEntry.description: The registry key that says how to render this widget. Exported even when absent, so no widget's position is lost; on import, entries without a type are skipped, since nothing says how to render them.

FlexiWidgetLayoutEntry.name: x
FlexiWidgetLayoutEntry.description: The column the widget starts at, zero-indexed.

FlexiWidgetLayoutEntry.name: y
FlexiWidgetLayoutEntry.description: The row the widget starts at, zero-indexed.

FlexiWidgetLayoutEntry.name: width
FlexiWidgetLayoutEntry.description: The width of the widget in grid units.

FlexiWidgetLayoutEntry.name: height
FlexiWidgetLayoutEntry.description: The height of the widget in grid units.

FlexiWidgetLayoutEntry.name: metadata
FlexiWidgetLayoutEntry.description: Custom serialisable data attached to the widget, preserved through export and import.

FlexiWidgetEvent.name: target
FlexiWidgetEvent.description: The target the widget is in or over. Undefined when it is over none (e.g. a cancelled adder drag).

FlexiWidgetDropEvent.name: sourceTarget
FlexiWidgetDropEvent.description: The target the widget was picked up from. Undefined for a widget added through an adder.

FlexiWidgetDropEvent.name: target
FlexiWidgetDropEvent.description: The target the widget landed in.
